blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Digital tools have changed supply chain work. An ERP system tracks orders, stock and invoices in one place. Tracking systems show exactly where a shipment is, in real time.

Dashboards turn thousands of numbers into one clear picture. AI is starting to help too. It predicts demand, spots patterns, and warns teams of problems early.

None of this replaces good people. But a good team with the right tools does in minutes what a great team used to do in days.

items.q: What does an ERP system do?
options: It tracks orders, stock and invoices in one place
items.why: "An ERP system tracks orders, stock and invoices in one place."

items.q: What do tracking systems show?
options: Where a shipment is, in real time
items.why: "Tracking systems show exactly where a shipment is, in real time."

items.q: What do dashboards do?
options: They turn many numbers into one clear picture
items.why: "Dashboards turn thousands of numbers into one clear picture."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
items.why: Inferência: "None of this replaces good people." O autor discorda que as ferramentas substituam as pessoas.

items.q: The last sentence suggests that…
options: Good tools make a team much faster
items.why: Inferência: "does in minutes what a great team used to do in days" mostra que as ferramentas economizam muito tempo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily mostrando o sistema para um novo analista. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team. Let me show you this screen. It is our ERP system.

Before, we used three different systems. Every morning I spent one hour to check the numbers. I opened one screen for orders, one for stock, and one for invoices. It was slow, and mistakes were easy.

Now everything is in one place. You open the ERP, and you see all the data on one screen. Orders, stock, invoices — all here. It saves us a lot of time.

Look at this part. It is a small dashboard. It shows our shipments in real time. You can see where each truck is right now. Green means on time. Red means late.

My advice is simple. Always put good data in. The tool is only as good as the numbers you type. If the data is wrong, the screen is wrong too.

Take your time to learn it. In one week, it will feel easy.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What screen is Emily showing the new analyst?
items.why: "Let me show you this screen. It is our ERP system."

items.q: How many systems did the team use before?
items.why: "Before, we used three different systems."

items.q: What does the small dashboard show?
items.why: "It is a small dashboard. It shows our shipments in real time."

items.q: Why does Emily say "always put good data in"?
options: Because bad data makes the screen wrong too
items.why: Inferência: "The tool is only as good as the numbers you type. If the data is wrong, the screen is wrong too."

items.q: How does Emily feel about the new system?
options: She thinks it is worse than before
She wants the old systems back
She thinks it saves time and helps the team
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "It saves us a lot of time" e mostra o sistema com tom positivo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We can see the truck in real time." Real time means…
items.why: Real time = tempo real: no momento em que acontece.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The AI can ___ next month's demand from old sales data."
items.why: To predict = prever: dizer o que vai acontecer no futuro.

items.q: "The system found a strange pattern in the orders." A pattern is…
items.why: Pattern = padrão: algo que se repete de forma parecida.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The app can ___ the team when stock is low."
items.why: To warn = avisar: dar um aviso sobre um problema.

items.q: "The ERP is a very useful tool." A tool is…
options: a thing you use to do work
items.why: Tool = ferramenta: algo que você usa para fazer um trabalho.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com ferramentas digitais. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "IT will set up the new system next week." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = configurar, deixar pronto para usar.

items.q: "The team will roll out the app to all offices." To roll out means to…
options: start using it in the company
items.why: Roll out = lançar, colocar em uso.

items.q: "Please log in with your name and password." To log in means to…
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com login e senha.

items.q: "The old files are gone. Can you back up the data?" To back up means to…
options: save a copy of the data
items.why: Back up = fazer uma cópia de segurança dos dados.

items.q: "If the screen freezes, just log out and try again." To log out means to…
items.why: Log out = sair do sistema.
